issues.title: Incoming Antimagic example exceeds the actual Burning Hands cone; define the direct-dispel exception per operation

Even a Medium five-foot footprint centered on B leaves its closest x=2.5 point 17.5ft from the caster. The frozen Burning Hands /operational explicitly has range15 and a15-foot cone. This is not a valid incoming-payload example. Also Greater Dispel selects an area center and captures applications; it does not select one target field at declaration, so the new direct-field exception needs an exact termination-operation meaning.
issues.proposedConcreteRepair: Keep field center(0,0) radius10 and caster(20,0), point the cone west, put B at(7.5,0) with a fitting actual footprint wholly/partly in the field and A at(15,0) wholly outside. State actual dimensions, LoE and cone inclusion. Give Burning Hands cost2, W1 RP30->28, then on a later legal turn Dimensional Door7 ->21, with actual Dissonance cadence below surcharge threshold. W2 Greater Dispel10 is a different caster. For its immutable captured set, specify whether the self-dispel exception protects only termination of each captured Antimagic application or the whole cast. Recommended NEW narrow completion: classify local payload suppression once for the captured termination operations before performing any removals; only the targeted Antimagic termination operation bypasses that same field, another Antimagic still blocks normally, and other suppressed captured operations do not spring back after the first field ends. If a different ordering is chosen, state it explicitly and work it. Include one other ongoing rank-eligible inside buff in X25 and show its actual outcome without a second scan.

issues.title: Occupied Wall resumption fixture cannot reach its stated initial position; make panel selection determinate
issues.finding: X12 suppresses only y[-2.5,+2.5],z[0,5], then says a standing Medium body occupying z[0,6] walked into x[-2.5,+2.5] across x=0. The wall from z5 to6 was never suppressed; this starting overlap is illegal without an explicitly legal posture change and clearance. The new rule alternates panel, panel/portion and occupied portions, leaving whether an intersecting body holds the entire fixed2.5ft panel absent or creates a body-shaped cutout unresolved.
issues.proposedConcreteRepair: Use a fully legal six-foot-tall passage by suppressing the fixed six panels y[-2.5,+2.5] by z[0,7.5] before the creature enters, with actual suppressor geometry that covers them. A body y[-2.5,+2.5],z[0,6] then occupies all six panel volumes at resumption. Recommended NEW rule: active suppression still clips exact intersecting wall portions; on removal of suppression, if a pending portion in a fixed logical panel intersects an occupant, hold that entire previously suppressed portion of that fixed panel absent until clear, never deactivate a portion that remained solid. Whole-panel suppression in X12 therefore leaves six whole panels pending. Previously active wall cannot be entered merely because a different part is pending. State this algorithm in the shared rule and full spell procedure; show six pending panels at t18 and their return at t24 with no push/cut. A different exact clipped algorithm is acceptable if its occupied extent and clearance are mathematically defined and the example follows it.
